candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 to gateway /v1/orders and /v1/checkout; gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200, fast).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side telemetry; whether payment 503 stems from its own fault or a dependency is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent chain: payment returns 503, order returns 502, gateway checkout 502. Gateway logs/metrics show healthy readyz and low latency, so gateway is not the fault. Root cause localizes to payment/order downstream failure; payment-side evidence is absent, so candidate is bounded but not fully substantiated.
